name: How long does rental turnover and pre-sale repair work usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does rental turnover and pre-sale repair work usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Turnaround typically takes anywhere from two days to two weeks depending on the property scope. A minor rental turnover involving drywall patching, baseboard touch-ups, and targeted wall painting usually wraps up within two to four days. More extensive turnover work, such as resetting loose floor tiles, repairing storm-related interior leaks, or rehabbing foreclosed interiors, extends the timeline toward one to two weeks. Because Abraham Becerra coordinates carpentry, drywall, and paint under one roof while managing needed sub-trades, scheduling conflicts between different contractors are avoided.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor punch-list repairs take two to four days, while extensive drywall, tile, and carpentry turnarounds generally take one to two weeks depending on project scope.
